title: The Peat Cutters
text: Peat cutters stand around a hole in the bog, spades lowered, not speaking. They have found a body perfectly kept, its skin gone brown as tanned leather, a torc of gold at its throat. Its face is calm, though its throat was cut.

options.label: Buy the torc from the cutters before they think to sell it elsewhere.

outcomes.text: The torc is old gold bound with older magic. It is warm from a throat that has been cold a thousand years.

options.label: The kindest asks them to bury it again and leave the dead to their work.

outcomes.text: They grumble but do it. Whatever the body was keeping down stays down.

options.label: The wisest studies the body to learn why its throat was cut.

outcomes.text: It was a sacrifice to keep something down, and the sacrifice is wearing off. The cutters go pale when they hear it.
